user_story: As a user, I want to interact with action buttons on the Challenging DOM page so that I can test the features of the application. Acceptance criteria: I should be able to see and click the buttons with texts 'baz', 'bar', and 'qux' which are represented by the selectors: 'a.button', 'a.button.alert', and 'a.button.success' respectively. Additionally, I should be able to verify that the page does not change when clicking the 'edit' and 'delete' links multiple times.
